entry.title: New: dsh-scrape-webpage
entry.summary: Fetches any http/https page and returns title, description, main text, heading outline and links, with stats (char/word counts, reading time, language) and top keywords; can download content images to the session workspace for vision analysis and dispatch them to registered analyzers via the scrape.imageAnalyzer service. Exact install spec: github:131cda1/dsh-scrape-webpage. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
